experiment: AC Rescue Lab — external verification of TCL and Haier against founder-supplied URLs
methodology: every URL was fetched directly via WebFetch and its content extracted independently — the founder's own paraphrase of each page was NOT taken at face value; in at least one case (TCL manufacturer page) the direct fetch found LESS confirmed detail than the founder's summary implied, and that discrepancy is reported below rather than smoothed over. One of the five supplied URLs (efifty.com) could not be fetched at all (HTTP 403) and is reported as unverified, not silently treated as corroborating.

source_2_independent_merchant.MODEL: HSU-24LQ13-R32-T3DB-B (hyphens instead of slashes — a formatting difference, not a different model)
source_2_independent_merchant.ATTRIBUTES_CONFIRMED: brand=Haier (Arabic: هاير), ac_type=split, cooling_mode=cold only, capacity=24000 BTU, inverter=yes, wifi=yes, series='Ultra' with nano-sterilization tech, barcode/GTIN=6932063890295 (new, independent unique identifier not previously available in Tawveeri's own data), energy class B
source_2_independent_merchant.ATTRIBUTES_CONFLICTED: none — a stated '60 Hz' operating frequency is consistent with Saudi Arabia's grid (Saudi runs 60Hz, unlike most of the GCC), not a conflict
source_2_independent_merchant.INDEPENDENCE_CONFIDENCE: HIGH — a distinct merchant domain, distinct from Amazon and Extra, carrying its own barcode/GTIN not derived from either internal source
source_2_independent_merchant.note: price shown (2,799 SAR promo / 3,749 SAR regular) differs from Tawveeri's own observed price (3,049 SAR, ADR-319) — expected normal retail price variation across merchants/time, not an identity signal (ADR-319 already established PRICE_USEFUL=NO for identity purposes).

haier.why: exact model number confirmed by an authoritative manufacturer page AND a second, genuinely independent third-party Saudi merchant with its own barcode — zero conflicts on any identity-relevant field (brand, model, series, type, capacity, cooling mode, inverter, refrigerant). This closes the specific, precise gap ADR-322/323 identified (only 1 independent non-Amazon source) with real, verified, non-Tawveeri-sourced evidence.

tcl.why: exact model number confirmed by the manufacturer's own catalog page and by a second, genuinely independent third-party Saudi merchant with its own barcode; the core identity-discriminating fields (model, brand, type, capacity, cooling mode, inverter) show zero conflicts. One minor series-name-spelling discrepancy is disclosed rather than hidden, and one of the three supplied URLs could not be verified at all and is excluded from the evidentiary basis for this conclusion — the YES rests on 2 verified independent sources plus Tawveeri's own 2 (Amazon + Extra), not 4.
